keyword: who gives the green jacket to a repeat winner
claims: The Chairman of Augusta National Golf Club presents the Green Jacket to a golfer who wins consecutive Masters Tournaments.
Repeat winners break the tradition of the previous year's winner presenting the jacket.
A player cannot present the jacket to themselves.
Only three golfers have repeated at the Masters.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters Tournaments in 1966.
Jack Nicklaus put the jacket on himself after winning back-to-back.
Nick Faldo was presented the jacket by then-chairman Hord Hardin in 1990.
Tiger Woods was presented the jacket by then-chairman Hootie Johnson in 2002.
As of 2026, Fred Ridley would present the jacket to a repeat winner.
In modern times, the ceremony requires the Chairman to perform this duty to maintain formality.
